title: Pilot
description: Records of the EV-G3 pilot (PRD 2.4, 14.4 'Pilot instrumentation', FR-MTR-09): consent, run and card tags, daily diary entries and exit-survey responses, each keyed by a pseudonymous tester id. S-24 and tilo-api write them; packages/metering reads them for the pilot report, which shows aggregates only. They hold the tester id, numbers and the tester's own short answers, never a name, an email address or task content (PRD 16.5). Each record is written on its own, so the root is a sampler with one optional property per definition, like common's; nothing sends a Pilot document. Rules MT-12 to MT-14 in contracts/metering.rules.md.

tester_id.description: Pseudonymous tester id: t_ and 6 to 32 lower-case letters or digits, assigned by Tilo. Never an email address, a name or a Tilo user id (PRD 16.5). The not-pattern rejects a final line break, which a Python validator's $ lets through.

consent.description: A tester's written consent to the EV-G3 pilot rules (PRD 2.4): no confidential employer or client data, test Google accounts or personal accounts only. The tester's records are deleted on delete_after, 30 days after the study, unless keep_data is true; withdrawing consent deletes them at once (PRD 16.5, MT-12).

tag.description: Tags a run (run id) or a card (card ULID) with the tester who used it (PRD 14.4: pilot accounts tag every run and card). Which id goes with which kind is MT-13.

diary_entry.description: The 5-minute daily diary (PRD 2.4) for one of the three pilot days: minutes the tester thinks Tilo saved, a trust score from 1 to 5 and, in at most 280 characters, what they did with the time saved.

survey_response.description: The exit survey (PRD 2.4): trust score, the share of saved time reinvested and how, and an optional quote. A quote is kept only with the tester's consent to quote it, so quote is null whenever quote_consent is false (BQ-66).
